name: Focal point
definition: The one place in a view that the eye finds first and comes back to. A composition has one primary focal point and at most two secondary ones.

measures.measure: luminance of the focal point to its surround

measures.reference: 0.5 on an axis, or 0.33 / 0.67 on a third

sources.title: Rudolf Arnheim, Art and Visual Perception: A Psychology of the Creative Eye (University of California Press, 1954; new version 1974)
Francis D. K. Ching, Architecture: Form, Space, and Order (Wiley, 4th edition, 2014)
